data.label: WebViewer app
data.description: Page of the webviewer app itself. It includes main entities: 3D viewer taking 60% of window space to display construction site model fragments, Gantt chart showing schedule activities in remaining space. Various tools are positioned around these core components.

data.label: Top bar
data.description:
Top bar of the webviewer app. It includes:
• Logo (opens app menu)
• Tools (Model Layers, Issues, Section Box/Planes)
• Search bar for model elements and schedule activities
• Filter panel
• Last data fetch status
• User avatar (opens profile actions)

data.label: 3D viewer
data.description: 3D viewer taking 60% of window space to display construction site model fragments.

data.label: Model layers
data.description: Model layers are a set of layers that can be used to display different parts of the model. They are used to display the model in a more detailed way.

data.label: Gantt chart
data.description:
Gantt chart showing schedule activities in remaining space. The structure comprises of WBS items as parents and schedule activities as children. 
The chart is used to track the progress of the schedule activities. 
It's divided into 2 parts: 
1) Left side shows tree structure of items
2) Right side shows schedule activities as bars. 
 Each activity has columns like 'Discipline', 'Package', 'Phase', 'Start date', 'End date', 'Elements' (number of elements from 3D viewer linked to the activity)

data.label: Data mapping
data.description: Data mapping is additional panel appearing above the gantt. It allows to fill out values for activities columns like 'Discipline', 'Package', 'Phase'

data.label: Properties panel
data.description: Properties panel is additional panel on right hand side of the 3D viewer. When nothing is selected it shows overview of the project. When element is selected it shows properties of the selected element. If schedule activity is selected it shows properties of the selected activity.

data.label: Search bar
data.description: Search bar allows to filter elements and schedule activities by name. It's located in the top bar of the webviewer app. While typing it shows suggestions of unique names. We can select one of them or continue typing to see more suggestions.

data.label: Context menu within 3D viewer
data.description:
When some elements are selected in 3D viewer it comprises: 
 1. Select all 
 2. Select same type 
 3. Isolate selected 
 4. Hide selected 
 5. Show all objects 
 6. Focus on selected 
 7. Section box selected 
 8. Set status (sublevel includes 'set installed', 'clear status' ) 
 9. Link (sublevel includes 'Link selected activity', 'Search for activity', 'Un-link selected activity')

data.label: Context menu within gantt chart
data.description:
When some activity is selected in gantt chart it comprises: 
 1. Un-link selected elements 
 2. Link selected elements 
 3. Select linked elements 
 4. Isolate linked elements 
 5. Collapse selected 
 6. Expand all 
 7. Collapse all 
 8. Show / hide Schedule 
 9. Open Mapping table 
 10. Deselect activity

data.label: Context menu within model layers
data.description:
When some model layer is selected in model layers panel it comprises: 
 1. Show / hide 
 2. Select 
 3. Create folder for selected 
 4. Link selected activity

data.label: Filter panel
data.description:
As same as the Search bar it allows to filter viewer's elements and schedule activities. It includes 3 tabs: Model / Schedule / Both. 
 Model tab comprises the following sections: Active Filters, Discipline, Package, Floor, Room, Progress, Status. 
 Schedule tab comprises the following sections: Active Filters, Discipline, Package, Floor, Room. 
 Both tab comprises the following sections: Active Filters, Discipline, Package, Floor, Room, Progress, Status.

data.label: App menu
data.description:
The list pops up when logo in the top bar is clicked. It includes the following sections: 
 1. Edit (undo / redo) 
 2. View (show cooordinates) 
 3. Camera (Orbit mode / Walk mode / Fit to view / Reset camera) 
 4. Preferences (Low performance mode)

data.label: Linking process across 3D viewer and gantt chart
data.description: We can link schedule activities to elements in 3D viewer and vice versa. We need it in order to align schedule activities with real elements on the construction site.

data.label: Applying installation status to elements
data.description: We can apply installation status to elements in 3D viewer. We need it in order to track the progress of the installation.

data.connection: WebViewer has top bar on the top as the main navigation element
WebViewer has model layers on the left as the main navigation element for 3D viewer

Model layers is the outliner for 3D viewer. It displays the whole list of models and every models includes tree structure of elements. We can load/unload models by clicking on checkbox in the left part of the model layer item. By clicking on item's name we select either group of elements or single element in 3D viewer
Top bar has model layers button to open model layers panel. The icon looks like 2 square surfaces above each other

WebViewer has gantt chart bottom part of the screen. It takes 40% of the screen height and 100% of the screen width. The ratio between 3D viewer and gantt can be changed by dragging the separator line between them.

Initially Data mapping panel is hidden. If some activities has empty values in columns like 'Discipline', 'Package', 'Phase' we can open data mapping panel by calling via context menu. Also if some activities has empty values, we see alert notification in the top bar with button to open data mapping panel.

3D viewer has properties panel on the right side of the screen. It shows properties of the selected element. If there is link between selected elements and some schedule activity, we can list all activities linked to the selected elements.

Gantt chart has properties panel on the right side of the screen. It shows properties of the selected activity. If there is link between selected activity and some elements, we can list all elements linked to the selected activity.
Search bar allows to filter viewer's elements. While typing it shows suggestions of unique names. We can select one of them or continue typing to see more suggestions.
